sentences.text: In the morning it was sunny and warm, so we had a picnic on the grass.
sentences.translation: 早上天气晴朗又暖和,所以我们就在草地上野餐了。

chunks.label: 主干二
chunks.text: we had a picnic on the grass

grammar.name: was 是 be 的过去式
grammar.note: 主语是 it 时,be 动词过去式用 was。

grammar.name: so 表因果
grammar.note: so 表示"所以",连接原因和结果。

sentences.text: We drank juice and ate many delicious things.
sentences.translation: 我们喝了果汁,还吃了许多好吃的东西。

chunks.text: We drank juice and ate many delicious things

grammar.name: 不规则动词 drank / ate

grammarTags.name: 不规则动词 drank / ate

exercises.note: drink 的过去式是 drank,eat 的过去式是 ate,都要单独记忆。

sentences.text: I took many photos with my father and my cousin.

sentences.text: In the evening we came home, and I felt very happy and tired.
sentences.translation: 晚上我们回到家,我感到又开心又累。

chunks.text: I felt very happy and tired

grammar.name: 不规则动词 came / felt
grammar.note: come 的过去式是 came,feel 的过去式是 felt,都用来说明过去的动作和状态。

grammarTags.phrase: I felt very happy and tired
grammarTags.name: 不规则动词 came / felt

sentences.text: I did not want to leave my uncle, but the weekend was really nice.
sentences.translation: 我不想离开叔叔,但是这个周末真的过得很愉快。

chunks.label: 主干一(主谓宾)
chunks.text: I did not want to leave my uncle

grammar.name: 过去时否定
grammar.note: did not (didn't) + 动词原形构成过去时否定句,这里 want 用原形。

grammar.name: was 过去式
grammar.note: was 是 is 的过去式,主语 the weekend 用 was。

grammarTags.phrase: I did not want to leave my uncle
grammarTags.name: 过去时否定

grammarTags.phrase: I did not want to leave my uncle
grammarTags.name: was 过去式

exercises.note: did not (didn't) + 动词原形构成过去时否定句,这里 want 用原形。

exercises.prompt: 仿写本句(替换主语或表语):I did not want to leave my uncle, but the weekend was really nice.
exercises.answer: I did not want to leave my uncle, but the weekend was really nice.
exercises.note: was 是 is 的过去式,主语 the weekend 用 was。
